label: First Name
description: Core identifier. Kyle collects first on every call. Required for PLRater Client Info tab.

label: Last Name
description: Core identifier. Required for PLRater Client Info tab.

label: Date of Birth
description: Primary rating factor. Kyle explicitly listed in required fields.

label: Marital Status
description: Kyle: 'We have to know if they're married or single.' Directly impacts rate and triggers spouse driver addition.

label: Social Security Number
description: Used by carriers for credit-based insurance scores. Also Kyle's informal lead qualification signal — reluctance indicates challenging prospect.

label: Mailing Address
description: Determines rating territory and garaging location. Kyle explicitly listed in required fields. Portal should use address autocomplete.

label: Own or Rent Home
description: Triggers multi-policy opportunity + homeowner discount on auto. Key cross-sell signal for home bundling.

label: Phone
description: Core contact field. May already be captured from call.

label: Email
description: Needed for InsureGrid link delivery follow-up communications and video proposal delivery.

label: First Name
description: Kyle: 'If there's any other driving adults living in that house.' Add another driver button adds a new driver card.

label: Last Name
description: Required for driver identification.

label: Date of Birth
description: Required for every additional driver. Each added driver requires Name + DOB + DL# at minimum.

label: Gender
description: Rating factor in most states. Required for PLRater Drivers tab.

label: Relationship to Applicant
description: Required for PLRater Drivers tab (spouse child other).

label: Driver's License #
description: Kyle explicitly listed in required fields. Not voice-capturable — portal's highest-value field. Required for MVR pull.

label: Occupation
description: Kyle: 'A lot of insurance companies rate on your occupation... the factory worker is not getting the same rate as a teacher.' Discount eligibility.

label: College Student?
description: Discount for child away at college 100+ miles. Kyle: 'Is your son at college?' Only applicable to drivers age 16-25.

label: Vehicle at College?
description: Related to college student discount. Vehicle garaged at college location affects garaging territory.

label: VIN
description: Kyle: 'And the VIN and the vehicles the VINs.' Not voice-capturable. Validate via NHTSA check digit. Fall back to Year/Make/Model if unavailable.

label: Year
description: Core vehicle identification. Voice-capturable as fallback when VIN not available.

label: Make
description: Core vehicle identification.

label: Model
description: Core vehicle identification. NHTSA decode supplements from VIN.

label: Vehicle Usage
description: Commute / Pleasure / Business. Affects rate.

label: Annual Mileage
description: Rating factor for many carriers.

label: Garaging Address
description: Only if different from mailing address. Relevant for 'Is the vehicle at college?' scenario.

label: Date of Incident
description: Screening criterion. Kyle flags 2+ DUIs as low priority.

label: Incident Type
description: Type of accident or violation. Kyle uses this for risk screening — 2+ DUIs deprioritized.

label: Description
description: Free-text or structured date/description of the incident.

label: Current Carrier
description: For apples-to-apples comparison. May already be captured via InsureGrid or voice call.

label: Policy Expiration Date
description: Timing — determines urgency and prior coverage verification.

label: Prior Coverage Duration
description: How long with current carrier — loyalty/stability indicator.

label: Desired Liability Limits
description: PLRater defaults; Kyle customizes per customer. Low priority for portal — Kyle prefers to set these himself during consultative step.
